summary: Round-3 Desferal compliance tracker fully tested on /ferritin (mobile 390x844). All 28 frontend assertions passed: section renders ABOVE ferritin-chart-section with correct title/subtitle, weekly strip has 7 buttons in M-T-W-T-F-S-S order with >=44px tap targets, live count updates on toggle, ARIA pressed state and slate-blue (#5B7C99) fill applied correctly, no red/orange colors anywhere in the section, monthly calendar prev/next navigation works and defaults to current month, calendar tap toggles+selects (dose input appears immediately), strip<->calendar share state, dose persists to localStorage 'thal.desferal' across page reload, calendar shows the small slate dot via .desferal-day class, Settings 'Clear all data' wipes thal.desferal key, ferritin add regression still works.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (a11y) — pre-existing, not introduced by Desferal

critical_code_review_comments: DesferalTracker.jsx onDayClick toggles AND selects on every tap as documented; behavior is intentional and verified.
desferalAPI uses absence-of-entry as 'missed' which keeps storage minimal and aligns with future fatigue-correlation join on date.
Optional: dose input has no min/max constraint — a user could enter negative numbers; consider min=0 step=50.
seed_data_creation: Tests cleared all thal.* localStorage keys before each run; created an entry by tapping the 15th of current month and a strip-toggled Wednesday entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desferal tracker fully verified on iteration_3. localStorage key is 'thal.desferal'; toggle treats absence as missed. Calendar onDayClick toggles AND selects (one-tap sequence: select+done+dose-input visible). Strip and calendar share state via desferalAPI. Settings.Clear All wipes the key. Existing iter-1/iter-2 features (Ferritin add, etc.) confirmed unaffected.
